scope.description: An optional single-figure direction for a user-requested person in a visible setting. Give the figure a simple continuous contrasting contour and broad flat interior color; reserve mottled or more descriptive paint for one selected patch of the ground or setting. This surface contrast makes the figure and its surrounding space read differently without prescribing a culture, costume, landscape, symbol, or narrative.
limitations: Activate only when the user requests one recognizable figure against a visible setting.
Preserve the user's identity, age, clothing, posture, action, and setting.
Use contour and flat color as representation choices, not as permission to simplify identity-critical details.
Confine mottled surface variation to a selected ground or background patch; keep figure color broad and flat.
Do not add Polynesian, Breton, religious, mythological, or primitivist imagery unless explicitly requested.
Do not copy a named painting, source photograph, costume, or recognizable figure arrangement.

rules.applies_when: The user requests one recognizable figure against a visible setting.
rules.instruction: Use a clear continuous contour around the main figure; let it carry silhouette and pose separation while preserving the user's face, clothing, and gesture cues as needed.
rules.observable: The figure silhouette reads independently from the setting and remains identifiable through a small set of color fields and pose cues.
rules.reject_when: The contour breaks into photorealistic edge detail, merges with background colors, or changes an identity-critical feature.
rules.avoid: copied figure outline, heavy cartoon inking, and unrequested costume motifs

rules.applies_when: The user requests a figure scene that allows stylized flat color.
rules.instruction: Keep the main clothing and body areas in broad, solid color fields; use only a few deliberate color divisions and reserve smooth or mottled transitions for a limited setting patch.
rules.observable: The figure is described mainly by silhouette and color relationships rather than continuous volumetric shading.
rules.reject_when: Gradients model every body plane, or flat fill removes requested clothing/material distinctions.
rules.avoid: global color wash, airbrush shading, and random color change

rules.applies_when: The user requests a ground or background with a visible painted surface.
rules.instruction: Allow one bounded area of the setting to carry lightly mottled or more casually mixed paint while keeping the figure flatter; keep this texture secondary to silhouette and action.
rules.observable: Figure and setting have visibly different surface behavior, but the selected patch still belongs to the scene and does not become decorative noise.
rules.reject_when: Mottling spreads over the entire image, obscures the figure contour, or invents a new atmospheric effect.
rules.avoid: all-over grain, decorative wallpaper, and photorealistic foliage

joint_checks.instruction: Keep the user-requested figure as a clear outlined silhouette in broad flat color while one limited patch of the setting carries more mottled paint; preserve the figure's identity and action.
joint_checks.observable: The figure and setting differ in contour and surface handling, yet remain joined by a coherent color relationship and readable pose.
